statement: The proof nonce is its own counter; a committed frame signs at a slot above every slot either side signed, in its author's lane (Left's an even distance above the committed slot, Right's an odd one), so no two frames of one Account ever share a nonce (a gap appears wherever the other side's slot, or an abandoned attempt's, goes unused); signatures are one per (signer, nonce, author side).
